plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Before a destructive shell command runs, lists exactly what it would delete or discard and lets you cancel.

plugins.name: cache-thermometer
plugins.description: Prompt-cache timer, 5-hour and weekly usage bars, break-even keep-warm.

plugins.name: dictation-cleanup
plugins.description: Strips um/uh and stutter repeats from dictated prompts before they are sent.

plugins.name: voice-picker
plugins.description: A Voices pane for the read-aloud plugin: play samples, pick a voice, set speed with a slider, toggle auto-read.

plugins.name: connector-trim
plugins.description: Strips empty fields, image links and padding from large connector results without a model; the full result stays on disk.

plugins.name: screenshot-shrink
plugins.description: Takes browser screenshots at half size, about a quarter of the tokens.

plugins.name: subagent-router
plugins.description: Runs reading and search subagents on Haiku or Sonnet when Claude names no model.
